observations: The outline broadly follows the outer cerebral region in the displayed native planes; no gross array shift is apparent in these views.
In native k=96, the inferior mask boundary passes above visible posterior-inferior brain structures; this image does not establish whole-brain coverage.
The contour is an estimated envelope, not a reviewed pial surface or tissue/cavity segmentation. Three planes cannot establish three-dimensional anatomical accuracy.
The source scan and its cropping/defacing remain unchanged; displayed native indices are not conventional reoriented clinical planes.
scope_decision: permit preparation of a bounded mesh of the unchanged estimated domain; actual meshing remains subject to its source-bound release
required_followup: report boundary approximation and domain support explicitly; count unsupported observations under frozen rules without enlarging the mask
